acceptance.given: A stale-input case is presented for success evaluation.

oracle.expected: Evaluation produces a non-success result and records stale-input rejection during the validation phase.
forbidden: The stale-input case is reported as successful.
oracle.observable: Validator result status and diagnostic category for the stale-input case.

acceptance.then: The stale-input case is rejected and success is not accepted.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain validator executes the stale-input case and evaluates its verdict.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the stale-input validator case and assert that its verdict is non-success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or preserve stale-input evaluation so the validator returns non-success for stale inputs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing validator result schema and reject only stale-input success paths.

slice_hint.state_transition: stale-input presented -> validator verdict non-success; aggregate success remains unavailable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The stale-input case has a recorded non-success verdict and no success authorization.

acceptance.given: Validator content is available for evaluation.

oracle.expected: An independent verification record confirms validator content against the frozen requirement, without relying solely on another verification.
forbidden: Validator content verification is omitted or inferred solely from another verification.
oracle.observable: Independent validator-content check output and its source-linked assertion.

acceptance.then: Independent evidence exists showing the validator content was checked.
acceptance.when: The validator-content check runs and compares the validator implementation or fixture with the frozen FR-3 requirement.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the validator-content verification check and require source-linked independent evidence.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Provide an independent content verification check tied directly to FR-3.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve validator interfaces while adding independent content evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: content unverified -> independent source-linked content evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A source-linked independent validator-content assertion is present and passes its structural check.

acceptance.given: Matrix evidence is infrastructure-failed during aggregate evaluation.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted when infrastructure failure is detected.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite infrastructure-failed matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate verdict, validity flag, and acceptance authorization after infrastructure-failed evidence.

acceptance.then: Infrastructure-failed matrix evidence invalidates the aggregate and prevents acceptance.
acceptance.when: The aggregate evaluator processes matrix evidence classified as infrastructure-failed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an infrastructure-failed matrix evidence case and assert aggregate invalidation before acceptance.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure infrastructure-failed matrix evidence forces an invalid aggregate and blocks acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep aggregate result fields compatible while enforcing invalid status on infrastructure failure.

slice_hint.state_transition: infrastructure-failed evidence -> aggregate invalid -> acceptance denied.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate validity is false and acceptance authorization is absent for the infrastructure-failed case.

acceptance.given: Stable and Candidate subjects execute for each Matrix Case.

oracle.expected: Each execution emits evidence containing identifiers for both the Matrix Case and the executed subject.
forbidden: Execution evidence cannot be attributed to its Matrix Case or subject.
oracle.observable: Per-case evidence records and their Matrix Case and subject identity fields.

acceptance.then: Attributable evidence exists for every Matrix Case execution.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain records execution evidence and the matrix evidence validator checks attribution fields.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select each Matrix Case execution evidence record and require matching case and subject identifiers.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Emit and validate evidence records that bind every Matrix Case execution to its case and executed subject.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Add required attribution fields compatibly; existing evidence remains readable while unbound records fail validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: subject execution -> evidence emitted with case/subject IDs -> attribution validated.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every Matrix Case execution has evidence whose case and subject identifiers match the execution context.
